Release 0.27.0

Use API-based commits for verification (#1002)

* Use API-based commits for verification

* Update release workflow to use simplified commit message formatting and improve readability of release instructions.

* Update GitHub Actions workflow to set fetch-depth to 0 and specify main branch reference for improved release process.

* Add sign-commits option to release workflow for enhanced commit verification

* Refactor release workflow to use GitHub CLI for pull request creation and streamline version bump process

* Enhance release workflow by adding a step to create and push a new branch for version bumps, and implement signed commits for better verification.

* Update create-release workflow to use the latest version of the signed-commit action for improved commit verification.

* Refactor create-release workflow to utilize GitHub Script for committing changes.

* Refactor create-release workflow to improve readability of git status command and enhance code clarity.

* Add CLA check to workflows for enhanced contribution verification

* Add permissions for actions and pull-requests in CLA check workflow to enable write access

* Update CLA workflow trigger from 'workflow_call' to 'workflow_dispatch' for improved manual execution.

* Refactor CLA and create-release workflows to enhance security by using secrets for GitHub tokens and streamline CLA check conditions.

* Refactor create-release workflow to replace manual branch creation and commit steps with the 'create-pull-request' action, streamlining the version bump process and enhancing automation.

* Update create-release workflow to improve formatting of commit messages and enhance readability of the release title and body.
